rationale: Correct EdgeConneX's ownership and milestone history without creating duplicate platform records. Direct sources establish EQT Infrastructure as the continuing largest shareholder group, Sixth Street-managed funds as a current minority owner from 2024, Providence as the former seller group, and Liberty Global as a former minority holder that fully exited on June 29, 2026. CPP Investments funded EQT's broader AI infrastructure strategy but is not separately evidenced as a direct EdgeConneX shareholder, so it is not added. Sites, campuses, AdaniConneX and Chayora remain outside the canonical company boundary.

companyFieldUpdates.name: EdgeConneX
companyFieldUpdates.description: EdgeConneX is a global data-center developer and operator headquartered in Herndon, Virginia. Founded in 2009, it develops and operates edge, hyperscale, purpose-built and build-to-density facilities for hyperscale, cloud, enterprise, content, network, technology and AI customers. Public materials describe more than 80 operating or developing sites across over 60 markets in more than 20 countries, with over 10 GW of additional planned capacity. EQT Infrastructure IV completed the Providence-led acquisition on November 5, 2020; EQT Infrastructure V joined in 2021, Sixth Street-managed funds completed a minority investment in 2024, and EQT AI Infrastructure acquired a minority interest from EQT Infrastructure IV and V in 2026 while EQT remained the largest shareholder group. Liberty Global fully exited its former minority interest on June 29, 2026. CPP Investments' $1.75 billion commitment supports EQT's broader AI infrastructure strategy but is not disclosed as a separate direct EdgeConneX shareholding. Individual sites, campuses, subsidiaries, AdaniConneX and Chayora are outside this canonical company boundary. No later company sale, EQT exit, Sixth Street exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.
